Hi again,
I just submitted a second PR, #36758, adding the first IsLocallyFinitelyPresentable instance for an algebraic category in Mathlib (ModuleCat R for any commutative ring R). The free rank-1 module is the small strong generator via Gabriel-Ulmer / AR 1.11. Companion to #36104. Would appreciate a domain expert review on the algebra/category theory side.

Also on this one I've addressed the review feedback and merged up to current master. If someone could flip the label from awaiting-author to awaiting-review that would be stellar.

Thanks, Lars
